title: Hospital Closing Charge Extended-Hold Percentages
content:
**Extended-hold schedule — Bed-Hold and Leave Reservations, hospital closing charge.** The hospital closing daily charge follows the extended-hold schedule on the leave's privately held days already charged, counted as the days recorded on the bed-hold charges posted on the reservation, together with the hospital closing entry's days (its days as booked, net of any reversed against it).

| Days counted | Percent of the schedule rate |
|---|---|
| more than 30 | 85 percent of the rate (the long-hold percent) |
| at least 15 and no more than 30 | 95 percent of the rate (the mid-hold percent) |
| fewer than 15 | 100 percent of the rate (the full-rate percent) |

**Thresholds on both sides (hypothetical counts).**

| Days | Count | Percent |
|---|---|---|
| 9 already charged, entry of 5 | 14 | 100 |
| 9 already charged, entry of 6 | 15 | 95 |
| 18 already charged, entry of 12 | 30 | 95 |
| 18 already charged, entry of 13 | 31 | 85 |

The count looks only at bed-hold charges already posted on the reservation and the entry being priced.
